claims.claim: C1 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15032859) is a verified same-dataset human-PRESENT / no-human ABSENT external UWB radar source.
The frozen SafeNest C1 adapter produces canonical ROLE_L-compatible inputs for a subset of sessions and fails closed for others.
Adapter availability on C1 is strongly class-correlated (ABSENT VALID ≈81.8%; PRESENT VALID ≈37.9%).
VALID34 is not representative of the complete C1 source population of 77 sessions.
Under current frozen governance, C1 is unsuitable as replacement final-selection membership for D1_FINAL_SELECTION_BOTH_CLASS_V1.
C1 may serve as external availability / domain stress evidence only (EXTERNAL_SAFETY_DOMAIN_STRESS_ONLY).
All six frozen ROLE_L panel candidates (B11,B23,B47,C11,C23,C47) were executed deterministically on the exact A6 VALID34 population (204/204 outputs; 0 non-finite).
Descriptive out-of-domain C1 breathing-decision behavior differs substantially across the frozen six-candidate panel.
A8 Layer-2 results are CONDITIONAL_ON_ADAPTER_VALID, OUT_OF_DOMAIN_EXTERNAL_STRESS, and DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY.
FAIL_CLOSED adapter outcomes are availability/ingress failures and must not be reinterpreted as ABSENT, NORMAL, or negative physiology.
C1 stresses domain/scale sensitivity; it does not estimate SafeNest MR60 deployment performance.
